// Item 3 fixture (MATRICES § D, type Accès calculé; § G, Q1). Each case is copied as a new file into a
// scanned tree of a temporary copy by tests/l0-pi-surface.test.ts.

// ── case: recepteur ──
export default function (api: any): unknown {
  const nom = "on";
  return api[nom];
}

// ── case: optionnel ──
export default function (api: any): unknown {
  const nom = "on";
  return api?.[nom];
}

// ── case: ctx ──
export default function (api: any): void {
  api.on("turn_end", (_e: unknown, ctx: any) => {
    const nom = "cwd";
    return ctx[nom];
  });
}

// ── case: espace ──
import * as kit from "@earendil-works/pi-tui";
export const lire = (n: string): unknown => (kit as any)[n];

// ── case: exclu ──
const LISTE_EPREUVE = ["a", "b"];
export default function (api: any): unknown[] {
  return LISTE_EPREUVE.map((k) => api[k]);
}

// ── case: duplique ──
const LISTE_EPREUVE = ["a", "b"];
export default function (api: any): unknown[] {
  return LISTE_EPREUVE.map((k) => api[k] ?? api[k]);
}
